description: This file defines the singleton class 'ShutdownNoReason', which implements the 'ShutdownReason' interface, representing a shutdown reason with no specific reason provided.

classes.name: ShutdownNoReason
classes.description: Immutable singleton class representing a shutdown reason with no specified reason, implementing the 'ShutdownReason' interface.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of shutdown reason, which is 'Unknown' with an empty string.

methods.name: isRelevantFor
methods.description: Indicates whether the shutdown reason is relevant for the given object; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts this shutdown reason to an empty JsonObject.
